old: export const links = (src: string) => [...new Set([...src.matchAll(LINK)].map((m) => m[1]))]
symptom: A note that links to the same other note twice lists that link twice in the graph.
The estimate of how many tokens the scanned source code would take is too high: a project of 40,000 bytes should count as 10,000 tokens.
When a note is converted to Markdown, finished checklist items come out unchecked and open ones come out checked.
The properties at the top of a note, when exported to Markdown, are written as key=value instead of the usual key: value.
When every note fits into the agent's project map, a bogus last line saying that 0 notes were omitted is still added.
In the link graph a note is drawn in the same column as the note that links to it, instead of one column to its right.
When a project is scanned, an import written with ../ (for example ../lib/x from src/ui) points at the wrong folder.
In a scanned project, the comment at the top of a file no longer becomes that file's one-line description in its note.
Upper-case constants such as PAY_LIMIT are missing from the symbols listed in a scanned file's note.
